description: Valid bridge.clipboard.connect packets for reconnect sync. Since BR-16 the phone sends the timestamp-only form: a reconnect is not a user asking for a send.

valid.name: clipboard_connect_empty_content
valid.comment: Parses, but carries nothing to apply: a receiver must ignore an empty content exactly as it ignores an absent one. Applying it would wipe the peer's clipboard. Since BR-16 neither side sends this.

valid.name: clipboard_connect_timestamp_only
valid.comment: What the phone sends on reconnect since BR-16: no content key at all. A receiver must ignore it, not read it as an empty clipboard.
